chunks: Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us, he said: Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Zakariya al-Qattan narrated to us, from Bakr ibn Abdullah ibn Habib, from Tamim ibn Buhlul, from his father, from Hafs ibn Giyath, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his fathers, peace be upon them,

He said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his Family, said: A time will come upon people in which the happiest among the people in this world will be Lak' ibn Lak' (a despised slave, son of a despised slave). The best of people on that day will be a believer between two generous men.

key_terms.لَكَعَ بْنَ لَكَعَ: A term denoting a despised slave or lowly person, son of a despised slave
key_terms.يُؤْمَئِذٍ: On that day / at that time

ai.seo_question: Who is Lak' ibn Lak' and what does it signify about social status in the end times?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, this hadith from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq highlights the eschatological inversion of social values, where the 'Lak' ibn Lak'' (a term for a despised or lowly slave) attains worldly happiness due to the prevalence of materialism. Conversely, the true 'best of people' is identified as a humble believer, emphasizing that spiritual merit outweighs social rank in the eyes of God. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the *Zuhd* (asceticism) of the Ahl al-Bayt amidst the rising influence of the Umayyad and Abbasid elites.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Ahmad bin Hasan al-Qattan, that he said: We were told by Ahmad bin Yahya bin Zakariya al-Qattan, from Bikr bin Abdullah bin Habib, from Tamim bin Buhlul, from his father, from Hafs bin Giyath, from Ja’far bin Muhammed, from his father, from his fathers, peace be upon them,

that he said: The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said: There will come, upon people, a time in which the happiest among the people in this world will be a despised slave, son of a despised slave. The best of people on that day will be a believer between two generous.
